targets.rawSql:
WITH detection_rows AS (
  SELECT
    (payload->'recording'->>'created_on')::timestamptz AS recording_time,
    species_tag->'tag'->>'value' AS species,
    COALESCE((species_tag->>'confidence_score')::double precision, 0) AS confidence
  FROM mqtt_messages
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload->'detections') AS detection
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(detection->'tags') AS species_tag
  WHERE message_type = 'detection'
    AND ingest_status = 'accepted'
    AND payload IS NOT NULL
    AND species_tag->'tag'->>'key' = 'species'
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', recording_time) AS time,
  species AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM detection_rows
WHERE confidence >= ${confidence_threshold}
  AND recording_time >= $__timeFrom()
  AND recording_time <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

WITH detection_rows AS (
  SELECT
    (payload->'recording'->>'created_on')::timestamptz AS recording_time,
    species_tag->'tag'->>'value' AS species,
    COALESCE((species_tag->>'confidence_score')::double precision, 0) AS confidence
  FROM mqtt_messages
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload->'detections') AS detection
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(detection->'tags') AS species_tag
  WHERE message_type = 'detection'
    AND ingest_status = 'accepted'
    AND payload IS NOT NULL
    AND species_tag->'tag'->>'key' = 'species'
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(0)) + make_interval(hours => EXTRACT(hour FROM recording_time)::int) AS time,
  species AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM detection_rows
WHERE confidence >= ${confidence_threshold}
  AND recording_time::date = '${recording_day}'::date
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Detections Per Hour Of Day By Species (>= ${confidence_threshold})

targets.rawSql:
WITH detection_rows AS (
  SELECT
    (payload->'recording'->>'created_on')::timestamptz AS recording_time,
    EXTRACT(hour FROM (payload->'recording'->>'created_on')::timestamptz)::int AS hour_of_day,
    species_tag->'tag'->>'value' AS species,
    COALESCE((species_tag->>'confidence_score')::double precision, 0) AS confidence
  FROM mqtt_messages
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload->'detections') AS detection
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(detection->'tags') AS species_tag
  WHERE message_type = 'detection'
    AND ingest_status = 'accepted'
    AND payload IS NOT NULL
    AND species_tag->'tag'->>'key' = 'species'
)
SELECT
  hour_of_day AS x,
  species AS y,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM detection_rows
WHERE confidence >= ${confidence_threshold}
  AND recording_time >= $__timeFrom()
  AND recording_time <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2, 1;

panels.title: Heatmap Of Detections Per Species Per Hour (>= ${confidence_threshold})

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  species_tag->'tag'->>'value' AS species,
  mqtt_messages.device_id,
  (payload->'recording'->>'created_on')::timestamptz AS recorded_on,
  COALESCE((species_tag->>'confidence_score')::double precision, 0) AS confidence_score,
  (payload->>'name_model') AS model_name,
  (detection->>'detection_score')::double precision AS detection_score,
  mqtt_messages.topic
FROM mqtt_messages
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload->'detections') AS detection
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(detection->'tags') AS species_tag
WHERE message_type = 'detection'
  AND ingest_status = 'accepted'
  AND payload IS NOT NULL
  AND species_tag->'tag'->>'key' = 'species'
  AND COALESCE((species_tag->>'confidence_score')::double precision, 0) >= ${confidence_threshold}
  AND $__timeFilter((payload->'recording'->>'created_on')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY recorded_on DESC
LIMIT 500;
